Hi team — drafted answers below that should be safe to send to Acme. I also attached a short telemetry_summary.txt with field-level detail. Please review and let me know if you want edits before Marissa sends.

1) SOC 2 scope & timeline:
- Current: SOC 2 Type I completed for production control environment (covers infra provisioning, change management, access controls). Auditor: Kestrel Audit LLP.
- Type II: Audit window scheduled for July 2026; expected report delivery by end of Q3 2026. Logging & monitoring controls (centralized logging, alerting, incident response processes) are included in the audit scope.

2) Telemetry collected by hosted Console & docs:
- Product telemetry (collected server-side): request timestamps, endpoints hit (path only, query parameters stripped by default), request latency, response status, error codes, model_id used, token counts.
- Routing/operational telemetry: instance id, region, hashed client IP (salted SHA256 hash used for routing only), user agent string (for browser console only).
- Console UI analytics (client-side): page view events, click events, anonymous session id stored in a session cookie. We do NOT capture PII fields from request bodies or query parameters; if a customer routes PII in prompts it's stored per their contract and data-retention settings.
- Docs site: uses a privacy-respecting analytics provider (no PII captured). Cookie usage limited to session cookie for docs analytics and an optional persistence cookie for consent; cookie values are opaque IDs only.

3) Retention windows:
- Operational logs (for debugging & routing): 90 days by default for hosted customers; option to extend via Dedicated/Private.
- Aggregated analytics (metrics, dashboards): 13 months by default.
- Audit logs & access logs (security controls): retained 12 months and available for export.

4) PII considerations & opt-out:
- We do not ingest or surface PII in analytics by default. Customers can opt out of client-side analytics on the Console and docs via cookie consent configuration. For hosted API customers, we provide a control to disable telemetry ingest for specific projects.

5) Next steps / deliverables:
- Populate vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx with these answers (I can inline the longer telemetry table in the spreadsheet).
- Provide SOC 2 auditor name and expected Type II delivery dates (see above).

Attachment: telemetry_summary.txt (field-level examples and hashing details).

Hope this helps — let me know if you want me to jump on the call with Acme.
